metadata.title: Your First Brutalist Project.
metadata.audience: Humanitarians AI fellows already using Claude Code
metadata.note: Portrait (9:16) companion of the landscape reel. Native 2160 x 3840 layouts — every beat uses a portrait-registered composition (Composer916, HesitantWriter916, CodeBeat916, VerdictArtifact916, TitleOutroHAI916). Not a crop. Narration text is authored short so the smaller portrait card can hold it. Code samples on B02 and B07 use tightly wrapped snippets that fit the narrower card. Same substance as the landscape master, laid out for a phone.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude UI, first-project ask, four-line plan. Portrait-native composer.
beats.narration_text: This is Liam, in for Bear. Your first Brutalist project starts here. One ask into Claude Code, one plan back. Not a demo — a claim with a clock.

shot.show: portrait composer with the first-project ask and a four-line plan

props.command: claude "make me a 60-second AI Explainer about how ribosomes read mRNA — 12 beats, Kokoro am_onyx"

beats.role_note: EXECUTIVE-SUMMARY LAW — hesitant writer. Correction: demo -> claim.
beats.narration_text: So here's the frame. Your first project is not a demo of a tool. It's a claim — a small research question, with evidence — that Claude Code renders into a one minute film you can rebuild, beat by beat. That is the whole method.

shot.show: portrait hesitant writer types the frame and corrects demo -> claim

beats.role_note: ASK-RESULT pair 1 — concrete first ask, portrait composer.
beats.narration_text: Here is a first ask, verbatim. A specific topic, a length, the beat count, the voice, and a hard stop at the review cut so nothing final gets built before you have watched it.

shot.show: portrait composer with the specific first-project ask

props.command: claude "use ai-explainer to make a 60s reel on how ribosomes read mRNA. 12 beats, am_onyx, review cut only."

beats.role_note: the seven concrete steps the pipeline touches. Portrait artifact card.
beats.narration_text: Claude Code does seven concrete things before you see a frame. It reads the skill, drafts the beat sheet, generates the audio, renders the scenes, compiles the review cut, writes the checks report, and stops. Every one leaves a file you can open.

shot.show: portrait artifact card with the seven concrete pipeline steps

artifactLines: stops for you to watch, before anything final

beats.role_note: review cut is a receipt, not publication.
beats.narration_text: The output is a review cut. Twelve conformed clips, one narration per beat, four thousand pixels wide. That's the file you scrub. Not a Short. Not a published master. A local receipt that says: the pipeline finished — now you judge it.

shot.show: portrait artifact card — the review cut receipt

props.artifactHeading: The pipeline finished. Now you judge it.

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — greeting Your Turn, paste-ready prompt, good/bad ask discussion.
beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this prompt into Claude Code in a fresh folder, and swap in your topic. A good first ask names one small question, states the length in seconds, and stops at the review cut. A bad first ask says 'make me a video' and hopes.

shot.show: portrait composer with the paste-ready first-project prompt

props.command: claude "use skills/make/ai-explainer to make a 60s Brutalist AI Explainer about [my tiny question]. 12 beats, am_onyx, stop at the review cut."
output: GOOD: one question, length, hard stop
BAD: 'make me a video' with no shape
watch the review cut — request ONE revision
